data.one_liner: Provides a customizable splash screen widget with optional timer or future navigation.
data.what_it_does: Shows a splash screen with a logo, title, background, and optional loader. After a set duration or when a provided Future completes, it navigates to the specified page. All configuration is done via widget parameters.
use_when: You need a quick, code‑only splash screen without native splash setup
You want to display a logo or loading indicator while performing async initialization
avoid_when: You require native splash screen integration for faster app launch
You need complex animations or platform‑specific splash behavior
strengths: Very easy to integrate with a single widget
Supports both time‑based and future‑based navigation
Customizable logo, background, loader, and text
weaknesses: Limited to basic UI; no advanced animation support
Does not replace native splash screen for true cold‑start branding
No built‑in handling for permissions or platform‑specific splash assets
